eligible_inventory.name: AMS.MEL.IR.C2.Common.Comms_Request
eligible_inventory.signature:
--  Submit inherited keep-alive while C2 is Attached or Enabled, without
   --  implicitly enabling. Uses the shared native Return completion engine and
   --  Session admission pool. Exhaustion raises the resource-exhaustion exception;
   --  other native failures raise a provider error. Submission is not completion.
   --  @param Channel Open eligible C2 owner; serialize its operations externally.
   --  @return C2 Return observer; use the parent package's Wait/Close and inspect payload separately from outcome.
   type Comms_Request is limited private;

eligible_inventory.name: AMS.MEL.IR.C2.Common.Comms_Result
eligible_inventory.signature:
--  Submit inherited communications test while Attached or Enabled. The
   --  provider send runs after an accounted native lifetime claim. Session
   --  admission refusal raises the resource-exhaustion exception; closed/failed
   --  channels and other native failures raise a provider error.
   --  @param Channel Open eligible C2 owner; externally serialize owner operations.
   --  @param Channel_ID Unsigned communications-test selector, not a channel UCI identity.
   --  @param Command_ID Canonical command identifier through its C2 compatibility subtype.
   --  @param Request_ID Unsigned communications-test correlation identifier.
   --  @return Legacy observer of an admitted future, not evidence of provider acceptance.
   type Comms_Result is private;

eligible_inventory.name: AMS.MEL.IR.C2.Common.Send_Keep_Alive
eligible_inventory.signature:
--  Historical C2-only access to inherited common Channel operations. The
   --  canonical common facade supports all five typed families through weak
   --  views; this compatibility child takes a typed C2 owner directly. Channel
   --  selectors and reports are shared with the common package, but the C2
   --  Return owner/result and this child's Comms owner/result remain distinct
   --  Ada types. Handles cannot be substituted across these APIs. These are
   --  wrappers of existing upstream Channel services, not additional services.
   --  Serialize typed-owner operations externally and do not race request Close
   --  against Wait. Native pending work independently retains provider lifetime.

   function Send_Keep_Alive (Channel : Control_Channel) return Return_Request;

eligible_inventory.name: AMS.MEL.IR.C2.Common.Submit_Comms_Test
AMS.MEL.IR.C2.Common.Status
eligible_inventory.signature:
--  Owned legacy communications-test terminal report or explicit rejection.
   --  Uses the parent's outcome/error types and the shared Channel report type,
   --  not the canonical common facade's distinct Ada result owner.
   function Status (Result : Comms_Result) return Outcome;

eligible_inventory.name: AMS.MEL.IR.C2.Common.Report
eligible_inventory.signature:
--  Read the cached result category without provider access.
   --  @param Result Legacy communications-test result to inspect.
   --  @return Success for a report or Rejected for an explicit upstream ErrorOr error.
   function Report (Result : Comms_Result) return IR.Channel.Comms_Test_Report
   with Pre => Status (Result) = Success;

eligible_inventory.name: AMS.MEL.IR.C2.Common.Rejection_Code
eligible_inventory.signature:
--  Copy the report under the declared Success precondition. The expression
   --  body adds no independent outcome check when assertions are disabled.
   --  @param Result Successful legacy result.
   --  @return Shared Channel report containing provider-returned command/request IDs.
   function Rejection_Code (Result : Comms_Result) return Error_Code
   with Pre => Status (Result) = Rejected;

eligible_inventory.name: AMS.MEL.IR.C2.Common.Description
AMS.MEL.IR.C2.Common.Wait
eligible_inventory.signature:
--  Copy stored text under the declared Rejected precondition; the body does
   --  not independently check outcome. The legacy diagnostic helper substitutes
   --  a fixed native-operation-failure message when the diagnostic is empty.
   --  @param Result Rejected legacy communications-test result.
   --  @return Owned diagnostic, using cached retry for text beyond the initial buffer.
   function Wait (Request : Comms_Request; Timeout_Milliseconds : Natural) return Comms_Result;

eligible_inventory.name: AMS.MEL.IR.C2.Common.Close
eligible_inventory.signature:
--  Await a terminal report/rejection through the shared native Comms engine.
   --  Results are cached for repeat waits. Timeout raises the inherited timeout
   --  exception without cancellation or consumption; other native failures raise
   --  a provider error. Long rejection text is retried and consistency checked.
   --  Unlike the canonical Ada wrapper, this legacy body directly converts the
   --  native rejection number; native enum mapping still rejects unknown codes.
   --  @param Request Open legacy observer; must not race Close.
   --  @param Timeout_Milliseconds Maximum wait in milliseconds; zero polls.
   --  @return Owned legacy result, independent of later metadata callbacks.
   procedure Close (Request : in out Comms_Request);

eligible_inventory.name: AMS.MEL.IR.C2.Common.Capabilities
AMS.MEL.IR.C2.Metadata.Metadata_Stream
eligible_inventory.signature:
--  Owned inbound C2 command/BIT metadata and optional communications reports.
   --  Command status is independent of request Wait: accepting a command is not
   --  physical completion and the bridge supplies no additional correlation
   --  guarantee. All kinds share a bounded drop-incoming queue ordered by
   --  successful enqueue, not timestamps. Serialize stream operations and Close.

   type Metadata_Stream is limited private;

eligible_inventory.name: AMS.MEL.IR.C2.Metadata.Metadata_Kind
eligible_inventory.signature:
--  Separately attempt communications-test callback registration once per C2
   --  channel while Attached or Enabled. An expired channel, repeated attempt,
   --  provider refusal or exception raises a provider error. The attempt flag is
   --  set before registration, so failure is not retryable. No capability gate
   --  is applied and no other callback registration is undone. Native code checks
   --  channel lifecycle, not an additional queue-active condition; this operation
   --  does not revive an inactive consumer. A closed stream cannot be used.
   --  @param Stream Open stream whose channel admits this first registration attempt.
   type Metadata_Kind is
     (Command_Status_Event, BIT_Configuration_Event, BIT_Status_Event, Channel_Comms_Test_Event);

eligible_inventory.name: AMS.MEL.IR.C2.Metadata.Command_State
eligible_inventory.signature:
--  Inbound event alternatives sharing the same queue and owned-copy policy.
   --  @enum Command_Status_Event Reported command state and inability reason.
   --  @enum BIT_Configuration_Event Supported BIT definitions, items and component references.
   --  @enum BIT_Status_Event Active/completed BITs and fault reports.
   --  @enum Channel_Comms_Test_Event Communications-test report from separately enabled registration.
   type Command_State is (Not_Set, Received, Accepted, Rejected, Cancelled);

   --  @param Stream Metadata consumer to close, leaving copied events valid.

   type Camera_Protection_Stream is limited private;

eligible_inventory.name: AMS.MEL.IR.C2.Metadata.Is_Open
eligible_inventory.signature:
--  Attempt one-shot registration in order: BIT configuration, command status,
   --  BIT status. No capability-advertisement gate or automatic communications
   --  registration is used here. Native code rejects a closed channel or prior
   --  metadata attempt; unlike sends it does not require Enabled. Partial failure
   --  leaves installed callbacks safely retaining inactive/failed queue state,
   --  marks the attempt consumed and raises a provider error; reopening is not
   --  a registration rollback. No partially open Ada stream escapes.
   --  @param Channel Open typed C2 owner on which registration has not been attempted.
   --  @param Queue_Capacity Positive maximum queued events, default sixteen.
   --  @return Owned consumer for the three base callback families.
   function Is_Open (Stream : Metadata_Stream) return Boolean;

   --  closed/ineligible channels and other native failures raise a provider error.
   --  @param Channel Enabled typed owner; externally serialize owner operations.
   --  @param ID Command correlation identifier, default zero.

   --  @param Config Opaque UTF-8 configuration text; empty text is permitted.

     (None,
      Invalid_ID,
      Invalid_State,
      Invalid_Parameters,

   --  @enum Invalid_ID Invalid identifier category, value 1.
   --  @enum Invalid_State Invalid state category, value 2.
   --  @enum Invalid_Parameters Invalid parameters category, value 3.
   --  @enum Insufficient_Permissions Insufficient permissions category, value 4.
   --  @enum Insufficient_Resources Insufficient resources category, value 5.
   --  @enum Insufficient_Local_Resources Insufficient local resources category, value 6.
   --  @enum Insufficient_Remote_Resources Insufficient remote resources category, value 7.
   --  @enum Unsupported Unsupported request category, value 8.
   type Mode_Result is private;

   --  @enum Not_Supported Upstream Return::NotSupported, value 3.

   type Return_Result is private;

   --  C2.As_Channel, Image.As_Channel, Health_Status.As_Channel,
   --  Instrumentation.As_Channel, or Track.As_Channel. It is a controlled
   --  owner of exactly one native weak common Channel view. It does NOT own

   --  library: after the typed owner and its Session close, common operations
   --  on a still-open View raise Provider_Error, while Close still succeeds.

   --  Every literal is a payload under Success, not an explicit rejection.
   --  @enum Return_Success Upstream Return::Success, native value 0.
   --  @enum Bad_Pointer Upstream Return::BadPointer, native value 1.
   --  @enum Fail Upstream Return::Fail, native value 2; successful future completion, not command success.
   --  @enum Not_Supported Upstream Return::NotSupported, native value 3.
   --  @enum Not_Implemented Upstream Return::NotImplemented, native value 4.

   --  Submissions are valid while the family's common lifecycle admits
   --  requests (C2/Health/Instrumentation/Track: Attached or Enabled; Image:
   --  Attached or Running). Session admission refusal raises
   --  AMS.MEL.Resource_Exhausted; any other submission failure, including an
   --  expired or closed View, raises Provider_Error. An admitted request owns
   --  the native family graph independently of the View, typed owner, and
   --  Session. Timeout_Error is inherited from AMS.MEL.IR; timeout never
   --  cancels or consumes a request, and a later Wait returns the identical
   --  cached terminal result. Close must not race Wait on the same request.

   --  preserving this distinct upstream entry.

   --  preserving this distinct upstream entry.
   --  @field Velocity_Velocity_Vn_Ve Covariance term for north velocity and east velocity,
   --  preserving this distinct upstream entry.
   --  @field Velocity_Velocity_Vn_Vd Covariance term for north velocity and down velocity,

   --  release status; explicit lease Close is the reporting path for release failures.

eligible_inventory.signature:
--  Limited owner of one native snapshot retaining a provider-owned registered host buffer. The
   --  Frame Lease borrowed path performs no bulk image-payload copy from the MEL provider's
   --  registered host buffer into Ada. This is not end-to-end sensor zero-copy: pinned Squall
   --  copies UDP bytes into that host buffer; no DMA or kernel/network-stack zero-copy is claimed.
   --  Small metadata is copied at acquisition. A held lease keeps a provider buffer checked out;
   --  slow consumers cause backpressure or possible provider drops. Public stream/Session closure
   --  can be logical while physical teardown remains deferred behind leases, requests and release
   --  obligations. Closing the final child can trigger retained cleanup. Finalization is
   --  non-raising and can deliberately retain resources after uncertain release. Do not race
   --  lifecycle operations on a shared Ada object. Independent already-acquired leases may be
   --  processed separately; the stream still supports only one receive/acquire consumer.

   function Acquire_Frame
     (Object : AMS.MEL.IR.Image_Stream; Timeout_Milliseconds : Natural := 0) return Frame_Lease;

eligible_inventory.name: AMS.MEL.IR.Image.Is_Open
eligible_inventory.signature:
--  A control-only attachment raises Provider_Error; it has no image leases.
   --  Dequeues and owns one native snapshot, copying only small metadata and retaining the
   --  provider payload by address and length. Uses the same Mono8 single-band validated queue as
   --  owned Receive. At most one receive/acquire consumer may operate on a stream at once;
   --  independent acquired leases can be processed separately. Stream Stop/Close stops admission
   --  and can defer physical cleanup without invalidating held leases. Provider callbacks and
   --  navigation completion are synchronized internally, not permission for arbitrary concurrent
   --  operations on one Ada owner.
   --  @param Object Image stream to consume; Start admits image callbacks.
   --  @param Timeout_Milliseconds Queue wait in milliseconds; zero is a nonblocking poll.
   --  @return Limited owner of one checked-out provider buffer and copied metadata.
   --  @exception Timeout_Error No frame is available within the wait; does not stop the stream.
   --  @exception Stream_Stopped Stream is logically stopped and no frame is available.
   --  @exception Provider_Error Closed/failed stream, invalid converted metadata or payload span,
   --  or native failure.
   function Is_Open (Frame : Frame_Lease) return Boolean;

   --  health.

   --  @return True while the local snapshot handle is nonnull.

eligible_inventory.name: AMS.MEL.IR.Image.Pixel_Count
eligible_inventory.signature:
--  Closes the lease and invalidates its borrowed payload, also on provider-release failure. An
   --  already-closed lease is a no-op. The retained buffer is returned through the published
   --  Buffer release operation when successful. Provider failure or exception makes ownership
   --  uncertain: the bridge deliberately retains the provider graph, exact buffer object and host
   --  memory to avoid unsafe reuse or unload. This is not successful buffer release; the failed
   --  release is not automatically retried. Explicit Close reports failure, whereas automatic
   --  finalization suppresses it and can retain resources for safety. Final-child closure may
   --  perform deferred channel cleanup. Do not race Close with a borrow, copy, or another
   --  operation on this same lease.
   --  @param Frame Lease consumed by this operation; its payload count becomes zero.
   --  @exception Provider_Error Native buffer release or deferred cleanup did not complete safely.

   function Pixel_Count (Frame : Frame_Lease) return Natural;

eligible_inventory.signature:
--  Synchronously invokes Process with a read-only-by-contract array aliasing native/provider
   --  storage, without a bulk payload copy. Array bounds are one through the byte count (one
   --  through zero if empty). The borrow ends when Process returns or raises: do not retain an
   --  address, slice, view or access object beyond that invocation. Keep the owning lease open
   --  throughout processing and do not race its Close. An exception from Process propagates
   --  without consuming the lease. Requires an open lease; enabled precondition checking raises
   --  Assertion Error on violation, while the body separately raises Provider Error for a closed
   --  handle or invalid payload address. No general thread safety or callback-quiescence guarantee
   --  is implied.
   --  @param Frame Open owning lease which must remain open throughout Process.
   --  @param Process Synchronous read-only processor; must not retain any reference to borrowed
   --  storage.

   with Pre => Is_Open (Frame);

--  Synchronously serialize current safe values through native contract version 16, including mixed RX/TX. Historical v1-v15 contracts retain frozen layouts/domains: v16 uses the v8 base, TX-v3 and modulation-v5 plus context, not interchangeable array strides. Full-batch structural validation and local copied-value preparation precede one unlocked provider Add, including empty batches. Ordered intervals/events and duplicates survive. Borrowed transient Ada/C backing lasts through the call; native values own copies (native buffer copies share fresh sample vectors). Invalid final configuration raises Constraint Error before provider Add; lifecycle, registration and provider failures raise Provider Error. Add requires an open Job before any Finalize/full Cancel attempt, even if that attempt failed. Enabled reporting requires usable prior registration; no delivery guarantee. Externally serialize all same-Job calls/Close. No automatic retry: provider may mutate before throwing, and normal void return proves neither scheduling nor event execution/RF emission. Snapshot remains unchanged.

   --  @param Intervals Complete owned ordered batch; not consumed by submission.

   renames Add_RX_Job_Intervals;

new_records.name: AMS.MEL.IR.C2.As_Channel
new_records.text: function As_Channel (Channel : Control_Channel) return AMS.MEL.IR.Channel.View; -- Enable an Attached channel; already Enabled is idempotent. Provider -- refusal or exception makes the native lifecycle Failed and raises a -- provider error; a failed channel is not re-enabled by retrying this call. -- @param Channel Open Attached or already Enabled owner; serialize owner operations. -- Returns a new weak common Channel view of this open Control_Channel. -- Raises Provider_Error if the Control_Channel is closed; no open View -- escapes on failure. The View does not own or keep this owner alive, and -- closing the View does not close this owner. See AMS.MEL.IR.Channel. function As_Channel (Channel : Control_Channel) return AMS.MEL.IR.Channel.View;

new_records.label: AMS.MEL.IR.C2.Close (overload 1/3)
new_records.name: AMS.MEL.IR.C2.Close
new_records.text: procedure Close (Request : in out Mode_Request); -- Submit both independent uint32 fields through the optional upstream overload while -- Enabled. Pending work retains C2, Session and provider; Close is not cancellation. -- Independent of every metadata owner, including Open_Calibration_Status. -- @param Channel Enabled typed owner; externally serialize owner operations. -- @param Command Both independent command and request identifiers to send. -- @return Limited observer of a complete calibration status or MEL rejection. procedure Close (Request : in out Mode_Request);

new_records.name: AMS.MEL.IR.C2.Close
new_records.text: procedure Close (Request : in out Return_Request); -- Idempotently release the public Mode observer. Pending native work retains -- its provider graph and admission permit until completion/safe retention; -- this call does not cancel it. Native failure raises a provider error. -- @param Request Observer to clear, externally serialized against Wait. procedure Close (Request : in out Return_Request);

new_records.label: AMS.MEL.IR.C2.Close (overload 3/3)
new_records.name: AMS.MEL.IR.C2.Close
new_records.text: procedure Close (Channel : in out Control_Channel); -- Idempotently close only the Return observer, not pending provider work. -- No immediate permit release or physical cancellation is promised. -- @param Request Observer to clear; must not race Wait; native failure raises a provider error. procedure Close (Channel : in out Control_Channel);

The body -- returns stored text without independently checking the outcome. -- @param Result Rejected Mode result. -- @return Complete owned diagnostic, with long native diagnostics retried from cache. type Command_Return is (Return_Success, Bad_Pointer, Fail, Not_Supported, Not_Implemented);

new_records.label: AMS.MEL.IR.C2.Control_Channel

new_records.text: type Control_Channel is limited private; -- Copy attachment configuration without provider access or text validation. -- @param Channel_ID Requested channel UCI identity and label. -- @param Platform_ID Platform UCI identity and label. -- @param Sensor_Location Sensor offsets and location identity to copy. -- @return Independent configuration value used by Open. type Control_Channel is limited private;

new_records.label: AMS.MEL.IR.C2.Control_Config
new_records.name: AMS.MEL.IR.C2.Control_Config
new_records.text: type Control_Config is private; -- Safe typed command-and-control channel and asynchronous command owners. -- Open attaches; Enable is explicit. Typed sends require Enabled, unlike -- inherited common operations which also admit Attached. Serialize owner -- operations externally. Native submission accounts lifetime under its lock -- and calls provider send unlocked; this is not permission to race public -- Ada owners. Future completion is not proof of a physical state transition -- or completed BIT; command-status metadata is a separate reporting path. type Control_Config is private;

Text is validated as UTF-8 by native code. -- The returned channel is Attached, not enabled; failure raises a provider -- error and no partially open Ada owner escapes. -- @param Parent Open provider Session whose native state is retained. -- @param Config Attachment identities and sensor location to copy. -- @return Attached typed owner; call Enable before typed command submission. function Is_Open (Channel : Control_Channel) return Boolean;

Requires Enabled and has the same -- admission/error/lifetime rules as full mode submission; not a new service. -- @param Channel Enabled typed owner; externally serialize owner operations. -- @param ID Command correlation identifier; defaults to zero. -- @return Mode request observer, not confirmation of physical operation. function Is_Open (Request : Mode_Request) return Boolean;

Admission exhaustion -- raises the resource-exhaustion exception; other failures raise a provider error. -- @param Channel Enabled typed owner; externally serialize owner operations. -- @param ID BIT command correlation identifier, default zero. -- @return Return request observer, whose successful payload may still be Fail. function Is_Open (Request : Return_Request) return Boolean;

new_records.label: AMS.MEL.IR.C2.Mode_Result
new_records.name: AMS.MEL.IR.C2.Mode_Result
new_records.text: type Mode_Result is private; -- Known upstream rejection categories mapped to native values 0..8. -- Session admission refusal is a separate exception, not one of these results. -- @enum None No-error category, value 0, preserved if present in an upstream error. -- @enum Invalid_ID Invalid identifier category, value 1. -- @enum Invalid_State Invalid state category, value 2. -- @enum Invalid_Parameters Invalid parameters category, value 3. -- @enum Insufficient_Permissions Insufficient permissions category, value 4. -- @enum Insufficient_Resources Insufficient resources category, value 5. -- @enum Insufficient_Local_Resources Insufficient local resources category, value 6. -- @enum Insufficient_Remote_Resources Insufficient remote resources category, value 7. -- @enum Unsupported Unsupported request category, value 8. type Mode_Result is private;

new_records.label: AMS.MEL.IR.C2.Outcome
new_records.name: AMS.MEL.IR.C2.Outcome
new_records.text: type Outcome is (Success, Rejected); -- Submit ConfigSetCommand while Enabled. Native code validates UTF-8 and -- copies the complete length-delimited text, rejecting embedded NUL bytes; -- it does not parse configuration syntax or establish timestamp semantics. -- Session admission exhaustion raises the resource-exhaustion exception; -- closed/ineligible channels and other native failures raise a provider error. -- @param Channel Enabled typed owner; externally serialize owner operations. -- @param ID Command correlation identifier, default zero. -- @param System_Time_NS Signed nanosecond count, default zero, with no asserted epoch. -- @param Config Opaque UTF-8 configuration text; empty text is permitted. -- @return Admitted Return observer, not confirmation that configuration is active. type Outcome is (Success, Rejected);

There is no -- independent outcome check in the expression-function body. -- @param Result Successful Return result. -- @return Provider Return value; inspect it separately from result status. function Rejection_Code (Result : Return_Result) return Error_Code with Pre => Status (Result) = Rejected;

This does not -- query a provider, validate spectral bounds or enforce native set/map -- uniqueness, ordering or the upstream 8-bit band-key range. -- @param Channel_ID Channel UCI identity, including its descriptive label. -- @param Height Reported image-buffer height. -- @param Width Reported image-buffer width. -- @param Bit_Depth Image dynamic-range bit depth, not necessarily storage width. -- @param Row_Pitch Image-buffer row pitch in bytes. -- @param Buffer_Size Buffer-size scalar; copied independently of image size and row pitch. -- @param Image_Size Image-size scalar; no product of dimensions is calculated. -- @param Number_Of_Bands Reported number of EOIR bands, independent of map-entry count. -- @param Format Reported pixel category, not a complete layout description. -- @param Sensor_Types Ordered sensor-mechanization reports, including duplicates. -- @param Platform_ID Platform UCI identity, including its descriptive label. -- @param Sensor_Location Sensor component-location value to copy. -- @param Channel_Types Ordered channel categories, including duplicates. -- @param Task_Schedule_Depth Reported queued-task capacity, not bridge scheduling state. -- @param ODC_Available Whether the provider reports an optical-distortion map is available. -- @param NUC_Available Whether the provider reports that it performs nonuniformity correction. -- @param Metadata Metadata advertisements; constructing this value registers no callbacks. -- @param Image_Bands Band-map entries in supplied order, without sorting or key validation. -- @param Nav_Frames Ordered navigation-frame reports; an empty vector is permitted. -- @return Independent capability value retaining all supplied fields. function Channel_ID (Value : Channel_Capability) return UCI_ID;

new_records.label: AMS.MEL.IR.Channel.Close (overload 2/3)
new_records.name: AMS.MEL.IR.Channel.Close
new_records.text: procedure Close (Request : in out Return_Request); -- Await completion or return the cached terminal result on repeated waits. -- Timeout raises the inherited timeout exception without consuming or -- cancelling work. Other native/provider failures raise a provider error; -- explicit rejection is a result, not that exception. Completion releases -- pending accounting through the worker, not through observer closure. -- @param Request Open Return request; must not race its Close. -- @param Timeout_Milliseconds Maximum wait in milliseconds; zero polls for completion. -- @return Owned terminal payload or explicit rejection, cached repeatably. procedure Close (Request : in out Return_Request);

new_records.label: AMS.MEL.IR.Channel.Close (overload 3/3)
new_records.name: AMS.MEL.IR.Channel.Close
new_records.text: procedure Close (Request : in out Comms_Request); -- Wait for a report or explicit rejection; repeated terminal waits return -- the cached result. Timeout raises the inherited timeout exception and is -- not cancellation. Closed handles and other native/provider failures raise -- a provider error. No callback registration is performed by this wait. -- @param Request Open communications-test observer; must not race Close. -- @param Timeout_Milliseconds Maximum wait in milliseconds; zero polls. -- @return Owned terminal report or rejection, independent of provider storage. procedure Close (Request : in out Comms_Request);

new_records.label: AMS.MEL.IR.Channel.Is_Open (overload 1/3)
new_records.name: AMS.MEL.IR.Channel.Is_Open
new_records.text: function Is_Open (Channel : View) return Boolean; -- Limited controlled owner of a weak native view obtained from a typed -- family's channel conversion. It retains neither typed resource, Session, -- provider Channel, Control nor library. A present handle can outlive its -- target; even a live target must pass its lifecycle check for operations. -- Closing this view never closes its typed owner or cancels requests. -- Serialize operations and closure of the same view externally; distinct -- views do not require serialization with one another. function Is_Open (Channel : View) return Boolean;

new_records.label: AMS.MEL.IR.Channel.Is_Open (overload 2/3)
new_records.name: AMS.MEL.IR.Channel.Is_Open
new_records.text: function Is_Open (Request : Return_Request) return Boolean; -- Submit the inherited keep-alive operation, not a typed mode command. -- C2, Health, Instrumentation and Track admit it while Attached or Enabled; -- Image admits it while Attached or Running. Expired targets or ineligible -- states raise a provider error. Session-wide admission refusal raises -- the resource-exhaustion exception; other submission failures raise a provider error. -- Successful submission does not establish future or command success. -- @param Channel Open weak view of an eligible typed resource. -- @return Admitted request whose worker independently retains provider lifetime. function Is_Open (Request : Return_Request) return Boolean;

new_records.label: AMS.MEL.IR.Channel.Is_Open (overload 3/3)
new_records.name: AMS.MEL.IR.Channel.Is_Open
new_records.text: function Is_Open (Request : Comms_Request) return Boolean; -- Submit the inherited communications test while the typed family admits -- common operations: Attached/Enabled for C2, Health, Instrumentation and -- Track; Attached/Running for Image. Session admission exhaustion raises -- the resource-exhaustion exception. Closed/expired views, ineligible resources and other -- native failures raise a provider error. Submission is not completion. -- @param Channel Open weak view of an eligible typed channel. -- @param Channel_ID Unsigned communications-test channel selector, not a UCI identity. -- @param Command_ID Command correlation identifier copied with all 32 bits. -- @param Request_ID Communications-test correlation identifier copied with all 32 bits. -- @return Admitted observer; pending provider work independently retains lifetime. function Is_Open (Request : Comms_Request) return Boolean;

new_records.label: AMS.MEL.IR.Channel.Return_Request
new_records.name: AMS.MEL.IR.Channel.Return_Request
new_records.text: type Return_Request is limited private; -- Payload of a successfully completed Return future, mapped to values 0..4. -- Every literal is a payload under Success, not an explicit rejection. -- @enum Return_Success Upstream Return::Success, native value 0. -- @enum Bad_Pointer Upstream Return::BadPointer, native value 1. -- @enum Fail Upstream Return::Fail, native value 2; successful future completion, not command success. -- @enum Not_Supported Upstream Return::NotSupported, native value 3. -- @enum Not_Implemented Upstream Return::NotImplemented, native value 4. -- Submissions are valid while the family's common lifecycle admits -- requests (C2/Health/Instrumentation/Track: Attached or Enabled; Image: -- Attached or Running). Session admission refusal raises -- AMS.MEL.Resource_Exhausted; any other submission failure, including an -- expired or closed View, raises Provider_Error. An admitted request owns -- the native family graph independently of the View, typed owner, and -- Session. Timeout_Error is inherited from AMS.MEL.IR; timeout never -- cancels or consumes a request, and a later Wait returns the identical -- cached terminal result. Close must not race Wait on the same request. type Return_Request is limited private;

Existing queued events can drain after channel closure or -- callback failure; an empty inactive queue raises Stream Stopped, while an empty failed queue -- raises Provider Error. Provider callbacks never call Ada. Malformed records are discarded; -- exceptions during callback copying/allocation mark the metadata stream failed rather than -- being silently counted as a malformed record. -- @param Stream Open public metadata owner; externally serialize use and Close. -- @param Timeout_Milliseconds Maximum wait in milliseconds; zero polls. -- @return Ada-owned discriminated event with independent nested data. -- @exception Timeout_Error Active queue remained empty until the wait expired. -- @exception Stream_Stopped Inactive or stopped queue is empty. -- @exception Provider_Error Closed owner, failed callback state, invalid conversion or native -- failure. type Metadata_Counters is record Events_Received, Events_Dropped_Queue_Full, Malformed_Or_Unsupported : Counter; end record;

new_records.text: function NUC_Counters (Stream : NUC_Stream) return Metadata_Counters; -- Dequeues one message and copies its complete ordered points into Ada ownership before -- releasing the native event. Queued messages drain after the channel closes. -- @param Stream Open NUC owner. -- @param Timeout_Milliseconds Maximum queue wait in milliseconds; zero polls. -- @return Owned NUC_TempData independent of all native owners. -- @exception Timeout_Error Active queue remained empty until the wait expired. -- @exception Stream_Stopped Inactive or stopped queue is empty. -- @exception Provider_Error Closed owner, failed channel cleanup, invalid data or native -- failure. function NUC_Counters (Stream : NUC_Stream) return Metadata_Counters;

new_records.label: AMS.MEL.IR.Health_Status.Metadata.NUC_Stream
new_records.name: AMS.MEL.IR.Health_Status.Metadata.NUC_Stream
new_records.text: type NUC_Stream is limited private; -- Idempotently closes public metadata consumption and wakes native waiters. It does not -- unregister callbacks or close the typed health channel. Callback state remains with the -- provider channel; channel destruction followed by bridge callback draining is the cleanup -- boundary, not public metadata Close. Finalization attempts cleanup without raising. -- @param Stream Public metadata owner to close; serialize against other uses. -- @exception Provider_Error Native metadata cleanup failure. type NUC_Stream is limited private;

new_records.text: function Open (Channel : Health_Channel; Queue_Capacity : Positive := 16) return Metadata_Stream; -- Limited owner of public health metadata consumption. Channel-owned native callback state -- survives public metadata Close; finalization attempts non-raising cleanup. Serialize -- operations on the same Ada owner. function Open (Channel : Health_Channel; Queue_Capacity : Positive := 16) return Metadata_Stream;

new_records.text: function Receive (Stream : Metadata_Stream; Timeout_Milliseconds : Natural := 0) return Metadata_Event; -- Returns an owned payload for the MFA Status Detailed Event kind. Requires Kind equal to MFA -- Status Detailed Event. Enabled precondition checks raise Assertion Error on violation; the -- body directly selects the discriminated component, so a wrong-kind component selection is -- also subject to Ada discriminant checking (Constraint Error), not a bridge Provider Error -- conversion. Consult canonical AMS.MEL.Status for shared data semantics. -- @param Event Owned event whose kind satisfies the declared precondition. -- @return Independent payload value of the corresponding event kind. function Receive (Stream : Metadata_Stream; Timeout_Milliseconds : Natural := 0) return Metadata_Event;

new_records.name: AMS.MEL.IR.Health_Status.Metadata.Receive_NUC
new_records.text: function Receive_NUC (Stream : NUC_Stream; Timeout_Milliseconds : Natural := 0) return AMS.MEL.IR.NUC.NUC_Temp_Data; -- Registers the upstream HealthStatusChannel NUC_TempData callback once per channel, -- including after failure. Registration may deliver synchronously. Failure publishes no -- owner; the retained callback stays inactive because upstream has no unregister. Events -- share one bounded drop-incoming queue; the owner stops after channel destruction drains -- in-flight NUC callbacks. -- @param Channel Attached or enabled typed health channel. -- @param Queue_Capacity Maximum number of queued NUC_TempData messages; defaults to sixteen. -- @return Limited NUC consumption owner. -- @exception AMS.MEL.IR.NUC.Not_Supported Provider answered NotSupported. -- @exception Provider_Error Closed channel, repeated attempt, other registration failure or -- exception, or native failure. function Receive_NUC (Stream : NUC_Stream; Timeout_Milliseconds : Natural := 0) return AMS.MEL.IR.NUC.NUC_Temp_Data;

new_records.text: type BIT_Status is private; -- Construct a fault report by copying every field without provider access -- or consistency checks among severity, state, data and implicated components. -- @param ID Unique identifier for this fault report. -- @param Severity_Value Reported impact, independent of lifecycle state. -- @param State_Value Reported set/cleared/unknown state, independent of impact. -- @param Time Detection-time count in nanoseconds UTC, not report-transmit -- time; no epoch inference or clock conversion is performed. -- @param Code Reported code or name of the fault. -- @param Description Human-readable fault/cause explanation, which may -- differ from the identifier's descriptive label. -- @param Data Additional isolation data, copied in order with duplicates. -- @param Components Individually implicated component identifiers. -- @param Groups Candidate-component groups where isolation is unresolved. -- @return Ada-owned report independent of the supplied strings and lists. type BIT_Status is private;

new_records.label: AMS.MEL.Status.Details
new_records.name: AMS.MEL.Status.Details
new_records.text: function Details (Value : Security_Event) return String; -- Read the kind-specific category number. Zero is unset for each concrete -- upstream subtype. Authentication values 1..7 mean subsystem, service, -- configuration-file, operational-software, mission-data-file, other-file -- and other-device authentication. Integrity 1..6 means configuration, -- bootloader, operational-software, mission-data-file, other-file and other -- integrity checks. File management 1..4 means configuration, operational- -- software, mission-data-file and other-file updates. Key management 1..6 -- means key load, generation, update, deletion, certificate load and deletion. -- System 1..4 means startup, shutdown, reset and fault. Sanitization 1..3 -- means zeroization, sanitization and classified-data erase. -- @param Value Event whose kind selects the numeric category vocabulary. -- @return Stored category without decoding; Ada-created values need not -- lie in a native subtype's supported category range. function Details (Value : Security_Event) return String;

new_records.text: function Software_Version (Value : About) return String; -- Copy the identifier assigned to an instance of the model. -- @param Value Identification/version-text snapshot. -- @return Independent serial-number text without numeric interpretation. function Software_Version (Value : About) return String;

new_records.label: AMS.MEL.Status.State (overload 1/3)
new_records.name: AMS.MEL.Status.State
new_records.text: function State (Value : Fault) return Fault_State; -- Read the reported impact level, separately from the fault lifecycle state. -- @param Value Fault-report snapshot. -- @return Stored severity; no component state is recomputed or changed. function State (Value : Fault) return Fault_State;

new_records.label: AMS.MEL.Status.State (overload 2/3)
new_records.name: AMS.MEL.Status.State
new_records.text: function State (Value : MFA_Component) return Component_State; -- Read the identity of the component whose status is reported. -- @param Value Component-status snapshot. -- @return Copied UCI identifier, preserving UUID bytes and descriptive label. function State (Value : MFA_Component) return Component_State;

new_records.label: AMS.MEL.Status.State (overload 3/3)
new_records.name: AMS.MEL.Status.State
new_records.text: function State (Value : MFA_Status) return MFA_State; -- Copy subsystem status fields without validating the state machine or -- aggregating component states into the overall state. -- @param State Overall reported MFA/subsystem operating state. -- @param State_Description Supplemental human-readable state description. -- @param Mode_Description Supplemental human-readable mode description. -- @param Transition Reported transition progress, independent of State. -- @param About_Value Model/serial/software/hardware identification to copy. -- @param Components Ordered subordinate physical/functional components; -- duplicate component identifiers are not removed. -- @return Ada-owned status snapshot independent of the supplied collection. function State (Value : MFA_Status) return MFA_State;

new_records.label: AMS.MEL.Status.State_Description
new_records.name: AMS.MEL.Status.State_Description
new_records.text: function State_Description (Value : MFA_Status) return String; -- Read overall MFA/subsystem state, not the state of an individual component. -- @param Value Overall status snapshot. -- @return Stored overall state without deriving it from component values. function State_Description (Value : MFA_Status) return String;

new_records.label: AMS.MEL.Status.State_Transition_Status
new_records.name: AMS.MEL.Status.State_Transition_Status
new_records.text: type State_Transition_Status is (Not_Set, Not_Transitioning, Shutting_Down, Transitioning); -- Copy a fault report with its nested data and ambiguity groups. -- @param Value Status snapshot owning the fault-report collection. -- @param Index One-based position within the stored fault count. -- @return Ada-owned fault report independent of the source snapshot. -- @exception Constraint_Error Index exceeds the stored collection length. type State_Transition_Status is (Not_Set, Not_Transitioning, Shutting_Down, Transitioning);

new_records.label: AMS.MEL.Status.Subsystem_Component_At
new_records.name: AMS.MEL.Status.Subsystem_Component_At
new_records.text: function Subsystem_Component_At (Value : BIT_Type; Index : Positive) return IR.UCI_ID; -- Count components that this BIT tests at least partially. -- @param Value Supported-test description. -- @return Stored component-reference count, including duplicates. function Subsystem_Component_At (Value : BIT_Type; Index : Positive) return IR.UCI_ID;

new_records.label: AMS.MEL.Status.Subsystem_Component_Count
new_records.name: AMS.MEL.Status.Subsystem_Component_Count
new_records.text: function Subsystem_Component_Count (Value : BIT_Type) return Natural; -- Copy one logical or physical tested-item name in stored order. -- @param Value Supported-test description owning the item names. -- @param Index One-based position, no greater than the item-name count. -- @return Independent Ada String for the selected name. -- @exception Constraint_Error Index exceeds the stored collection length. function Subsystem_Component_Count (Value : BIT_Type) return Natural;

new_records.label: AMS.MEL.Status.Subsystem_ID (overload 1/2)
new_records.name: AMS.MEL.Status.Subsystem_ID
new_records.text: function Subsystem_ID (Value : Security_Event) return IR.UCI_ID; -- Copy subtype-specific audit details, without inferring an account-access -- meaning from the base class's generic member comment. -- @param Value Flattened security-event snapshot. -- @return Independent Ada String containing stored detail text. function Subsystem_ID (Value : Security_Event) return IR.UCI_ID;

new_records.label: AMS.MEL.Status.Subsystem_ID (overload 2/2)
new_records.name: AMS.MEL.Status.Subsystem_ID
new_records.text: function Subsystem_ID (Value : Security_Audit_Record) return IR.UCI_ID; -- Read when the security event occurred, without interpreting a clock epoch. -- @param Value Security-audit snapshot. -- @return Signed nanosecond count; unlike some BIT fields, the pinned audit -- declaration does not even specify UTC. No clock conversion is performed. function Subsystem_ID (Value : Security_Audit_Record) return IR.UCI_ID;

new_records.label: AMS.MEL.Status.System_Name
new_records.name: AMS.MEL.Status.System_Name
new_records.text: function System_Name (Value : Foreign_Key) return String; -- Copy an external identifier's key text. -- @param Value External-system reference. -- @return Independent Ada String containing the stored key. function System_Name (Value : Foreign_Key) return String;

new_records.label: AMS.MEL.Status.Temperature_C
new_records.name: AMS.MEL.Status.Temperature_C
new_records.text: function Temperature_C (Value : MFA_Component) return Long_Float; -- Read the component's reported capability state. -- @param Value Component-status snapshot. -- @return Stored component state, independent of overall MFA state. function Temperature_C (Value : MFA_Component) return Long_Float;

new_records.label: AMS.MEL.Status.Temperature_State
new_records.name: AMS.MEL.Status.Temperature_State
new_records.text: type Temperature_State is (Not_Set, Under_Temp, Normal, Over_Temp_Warning, Over_Temp_Degraded, Over_Temp_Shutdown); -- Capability-related state of one subsystem component, not overall MFA state. -- @enum Not_Set No component-state value has been set. -- @enum Unknown The component's state is unknown. -- @enum Not_Installed The component is not installed. -- @enum Off Installed but not powered on. -- @enum Initializing Hardware components or software elements are initializing. -- @enum Operational Able to perform advertised capabilities. -- @enum Degraded Degraded but still supports at least one capability. -- @enum Disabled Not enabled, or explicitly disabled, to perform capabilities. -- @enum Faulted Incapable of supporting any capability. type Temperature_State is (Not_Set, Under_Temp, Normal, Over_Temp_Warning, Over_Temp_Degraded, Over_Temp_Shutdown);

new_records.label: AMS.MEL.Status.Temperature_Status
new_records.name: AMS.MEL.Status.Temperature_Status
new_records.text: function Temperature_Status (Value : MFA_Component) return Temperature_State; -- Read the reported numeric temperature without unit conversion. -- @param Value Component-status snapshot. -- @return Stored temperature in degrees Celsius, not Kelvin or Fahrenheit. function Temperature_Status (Value : MFA_Component) return Temperature_State;

new_records.text: function Timestamp_NS (Value : Security_Audit_Record) return Long_Long_Integer; -- Copy the identity assigned to the audited security event. -- @param Value Security-audit snapshot. -- @return Event identifier with its UUID bytes and descriptive label. function Timestamp_NS (Value : Security_Audit_Record) return Long_Long_Integer;

new_records.text: function Transition_Status (Value : MFA_Status) return State_Transition_Status; -- Copy supplemental human-readable operating-mode information. -- @param Value Overall status snapshot. -- @return Independent mode-description String, not an executable mode command. function Transition_Status (Value : MFA_Status) return State_Transition_Status;
